text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends a U-turn prohibition on Lockie Avenue, between Agincourt Drive and Midland Avenue. Prohibiting U-turns will provide a safer environment for all road users along this section of Lockie Avenue located adjacent to Agincourt Junior Public School.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Lockie Avenue, between Agincourt Drive and Midland Avenue.
